dri med 'od las/ 'jig rten gyi kun rdzob tu me long lta bu'i ye shes la sogs pas dbye bas phung po dang khams rnam par dag pa las thabs shes rab kyi phyogs su dbang po rtul po'i sems can gyi bsam pa'i dbang gis de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs so// zhes so// gsum pa gdul bya gang zag gi khyad par ni/ skyes pa 'dul ba la pha rgyud/ bud med 'dul ba'i don du ma rgyud de/ gur las/ skyes bu 'dul bar mdzad don du// rnal 'byor rgyud rnams rab bshad la// btsun mo rnams ni bsdu ba'i phyir// rnal 'byor ma yi rgyud rab bshad// ces dang*/ gzhan rang sde dang*/ gzhan sde dag lha pho mo shas che chung gis 'byed pa'ang*/ rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud kyi don la 'jug pa las/ gang du skyes pa dang rang gi sde pa 'dul ba'i phyir lha pho'i rnam pa mang bar ston pa ni thabs kyi rgyud do// gang du bud med dang phyi rol mu stegs can 'dul ba'i phyir de dag dang rjes su mthun pa'i lha mo'i rnam pa mang ba'i dkyil 'khor ston pa ni shes rab kyi rgyud do// zhes so// rgyal ba'i dbang pos/ lus dang bsam pa'i dbye bas 'byed par gsungs la/ khyad par de dag shas che ba'i phyogs re re ba mtshon nas bstan pa tsam yin no// gzhan ston pa dang*/ zhu ba po dang*/ sdud pa po'i khyad par phye ba'i 'byed chos dag ni lung gis dngos su zin par mi snang bas bzhag go /bzhi pa nges don du thams cad gnyis med kyi rgyud du bstan pa ni/ de ltar dman pa la mos pa rnams drang ba'i don du thabs shes rab kyi rgyud so sor phyi nas gsungs kyi/ nges pa'i don du thams cad thabs shes rab gnyis su med pa'i rgyud yin te/ rnal 'byor gyi go don thabs shes rab gnyis med du sbyor ba yin la/ de pha rgyud ma rgyud gnyis ka'i brjod bya yin pa'i phyir te/ 'dus pa phyi ma las thabs dang shes rab snyoms 'jug pa/

rnal 'byor zhes ni bshad pa yin// gang gi dngos med shes rab ste// thabs ni dngos po'i mtshan nyid do// zhes bshad cing*/ kye'i rdo rje las/ he'i snying rje chen po ste// badzra'ang shes rab brjod par bya// thabs dang shes rab bdag nyid rgyud// de ni nga yis bshad kyis nyon// zhes gsungs shing*/ bde mchog nyung ngu'i rgyud las kyang*/ shes rab thabs kyi kun sbyor bzhin// sngags bzlas bsam gtan la sogs ldan// sbyor nyid cho ga'i ye shes ni// rgyud las gsungs pa mnyan par gyis// zhes gsungs la/ dus 'khor rtsa rgyud las kyang*/ rnal 'byor thabs kyi lus kyi min// shes rab gcig pus 'gyur ma yin// thabs dang shes rab snyoms 'jug pa// de bzhin gshegs pas rnal 'byor gsungs// zhes dang*/ rdo rje snying 'grel las/ shes rab thabs kyi bdag nyid rgyud// rnal 'byor rgyud du brjod par bya// rnal 'byor thabs kyi sgra yis ni// shes rab sgras kyang 'gyur ba min// 'di ni rnal 'byor rgyud ces bya// kye yi rdo rje gnyis rtog med// 'dus pa la sogs thams cad rnams// shes rab thabs kyi bdag nyid des// thams cad rnal 'byor rgyud yin te// shes rab thabs kyi ming rnams kyis// zhes gsungs shing*/ dri med 'od las kyang*/ rang gi ngo bos ni thams cad shes rab dang thabs kyi bdag nyid can rnal 'byor gyi rgyud nyid do// zhes pa dang*/ de'i phyir rgyud gang la thabs dang shes rab kyi brjod par bya ba yod pa'i rgyud de ni don dam par shes rab kyi rgyud kyang ma yin la/ thabs kyi rgyud kyang ma yin no// zhes gsungs so// de bas drang don du kye'i rdo rje dang dus kyi 'khor lo'ang ma rgyud du bshad/ nges pa'i don du pha ma'i rgyud thams cad gnyis med kyi rgyud du bshad pa'i 'od dkar 'dis ris med pa la ris su phye nas kye'i rdo rje dang dus 'khor ni gnyis med kyi rgyud/

gzhan dag ni pha dang ma la sogs pa'o snyam sems pa dang*/ zab pa gnyis su med pa'i rgyud kye'i rdo rje dang*/ rgya che ba gnyis su med pa'i rgyud dus kyi 'khor lo zhes spyi brtol du smras pa'i mun par brdeg 'chos pa dag phyin chad dbugs phyin par gyur cig /bzhi pa gzhung rnam par gzhag pa ni/ ye shes rdo rje kun las btus pa'i rgyud las/ rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud kyi ming stong phrag bcu gnyis zhes bya ste/ rgyas par byas na grangs med do// gnyis ka'i rgyud stong phrag drug go /spyod pa'i rgyud stong phrag brgyad do// bya ba'i rgyud stong phrag bzhi'o// zhes gsungs pa dang*/ sdom 'byung las/ rnal 'byor rgyud rnams kyi ni tshad// bye ba phrag ni drug tu nges// de bzhin rnal 'byor ma rgyud grangs// bye ba phrag ni bcu drug grags// zhes gsungs shing*/ sangs rgyas thod par yang de dang 'dra bar gsungs pa la/ sa ra has/ rnal 'byor rgyud la ni bye ba phrag drug nyid do zhes bya ba ni rnal 'byor gyi rgyud rnam pa drug la'o// rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud la ni bye ba phrag bcu drug nyid do zhes pa ni rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud rnam pa bcu drug la'o// zhes rnal 'byor rgyud sde rnam pa drug dang*/ rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud sde bcu drug tu phye nas re re la bye ba phrag re rer 'byed pa'i tshul cig gsungs la/ de dag kyang rgyud kyi ming so so ba'i grangs yin gyi shlo ka'i grangs gzung ba ni ma yin no// gzhan yang rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi rgyud las/ gsang ba 'dus pa stong phrag gcig /ces bya ba la sogs pa ni/ rnal 'byor pha'i rgyud bye ba phrag drug yod pa rnams rnam par 'byed pa'i don du gsungs la/ gur las/ mkha' 'gro bde dang rgya mtsho bde dang nam mkha' dang*// gser gyi char pa dang ni dga' chen za nus dang*// bde chen dgyes pa dang ni gsang ba yid bde dang*// rgyud sde rnams la phan pa'i rdo rje mkha' 'gro dang*// sangs rgyas thams cad dgyes pa'i rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor dang*// gsang ba'i mdzod dang rdo rje bdud rtsi las byung ba// 'khor lo bde mchog gur dang phun sum tshogs pa rnams// rnal 'byor ma yi rgyud ni drug par grags pa yin// zhes pas rnam grangs bcu gsum gsungs pa 'di ni ma'i rgyud bye ba phrag bcu drug pa rnam par 'byed pa'i dang*/

yang gsal byed so drug dag pas pha rgyud/ dbyangs so drug dag pas ma rgyud so drug tu dus 'khor bsdus rgyud las bshad de/ sogs yi ge sum cu ha ya ra wa la ra ldan kṣa dang bcas pa sum cu rtsa drug nyid// dbyangs kyi rnam par 'gyur bas phye ba ro yis bsgyur ba'i ro ni 'khor lo'i mgon po rnams su 'gyur// sku ni gnyis po nges pa cig gi 'khor dang bcas pa gnyis ni shes rab dag gis 'khyud par 'gyur// lnga yi bdag nyid lnga yi 'gyur te 'khor dang bcas pa dgu ni 'khor lo'i mgon po dgu bdag nyid// dbyangs kyi grangs ni bdag nyid bcu gsum dgu dang phyogs rnams kyis kyang sum cu rtsa drug bdag nyid de// ya la sogs pa rnams kyi sgo skyong mtha' dag tshogs kyi rigs ni lhag ma'i dbyangs rnams nyid kyis so// khro bo drug tu ha sogs kyis 'gyur rang rig phyogs su gnas rnams rlung gi dbyangs sogs dbye ba yis// so sor yi ge'i dbye ba rnams kyi ro yis bsgyur ba'i ro ni rnal 'byor ma dang rnal 'byor rgyud// ces so// yang sgron gsal du/ gsal byed sum cu rtsa gsum ming gi mtha' can gyi rgyud sde thams cad kyi rtsa bar gyur pa'i dpal 'dus pa ni rtsa ba'i rgyud yin la/ rgyud gzhan thams cad ni de las gyes pa'i yan lag lta bu yin no// zhes kyang gsungs so// de dag ci rigs pa bod na 'gyur snang zhing*/ phal cher mi snang la/ sngar 'gyur ba'i dkar chag la yod pa'ang da lta mi snang ngo zhes bu ston gsung ngo*// de ltar bshad pa'i bya ba'i rgyud de la'ang*/ bya ba so so'i rgyud dang*/ spyi'i rgyud gnyis/ dang po la/ rigs drug las/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs la'ang*/ dam tshig gsum bkod pa la sogs pa rigs kyi gtso bo'i rgyud dang*/ 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud la sogs pa rigs kyi bdag po'i dang*/ dbang bskur ba'i gzungs la sogs pa rigs kyi yum gyi dang*/

gdugs dkar mo can la sogs pa gtsug tor gyi dang*/ khro bo rnam par rgyal ba'i rtog pa'i gsang rgyud la sogs pa rigs kyi khro bo khro mo'i dang*/ sgo bzang po'i gzungs la sogs pa rigs kyi pho nya mo'i dang*/ spyan ras gzigs kyi mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa'i gzungs sngags la sogs pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs su 'dus pa'i byang sems kyi dang*/ mdo chen po 'dus pa chen po'i mdo la sogs pa gnas gtsang gi lha'i rgyud de brgyad du rnam par gzhag go /gnyis pa padma'i rigs la'ang*/ tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa'i mdo la sogs pa rigs kyi gtso bo'i dang*/ spyan ras gzigs kyi rtsa rgyud padma'i dra ba la sogs pa rigs kyi bdag po'i dang*/ sgrol ma las sna tshogs pa'i rgyud la sogs pa rigs kyi yum gyi dang*/ rta mgrin gyi rgyud chen po dpal sdom pa la sogs pa rigs kyi khro bo khro mo'i dang*/ phyir bzlog pa stobs chen gyi gzungs la sogs pa rigs kyi bka' nyan pho mo'i rgyud de lngar bzhag go /gsum pa rdo rje'i rigs la'ang*/ las kyi sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sbyong ba zhes bya ba mi 'khrugs pa'i gzungs lta bu rigs kyi gtso bo'i rgyud dang*/ rig pa mchog la sogs pa rigs kyi bdag po'i dang*/ rdo rje mi pham pa me ltar rab tu rmongs byed kyi gzungs la sogs pa rigs kyi yum gyi dang*/ bdud rtsi thabs sbyor gyi snying po bzhi pa'i gzungs la sogs pa rigs kyi khro bo khro mo'i dang*/ stobs po che'i gzungs la sogs pa rigs kyi pho nya dang phyag brnyan pho mo'i rgyud de lngar bshad do/ nor bu bzang po'i gzungs la sogs pa nor can gyi rgyud dang*/ me kha la'i gzungs la sogs pa lngas rtsen gyi rgyud dang*/ rig sngags kyi rgyal po dbugs chen po la sogs pa 'jig rten pa'i rigs kyi rgyud de/ de dag tu bzhag tu med cing zhar las bshad pa 'jig rten pa'i lha drag po dang*/

nor lha'i bu dang*/ tshangs pa dang*/ nyi ma dang*/ nam mkha' lding dang*/ gtum byed dang*/ me lha dang*/ phur bu gsum pa dang*/ klu'i rgyal po dang*/ mtshan mo rgyu ba dang*/ rgyal po bzhi dang*/ lha min dbang po dang*/ lha'i bdag po rnams kyis bshad pa de dag kyang rang rang gi gzhung nas 'byung ba'i tshul cho ga gzhan dang ma 'dres par rang rang gi lha la dad cing the tshom med par bsgrubs na 'grub par dpung bzang las bshad do// gnyis pa bya ba spyi'i rgyud la/ rigs thams cad mnyes par bya ba'i thabs su gyur pa/ 'jug pa dang*/ sbyor ba dang*/ sgrub pa dang*/ grub pa'i spyod pa rnams 'dus shing tshang la/ gsal ba dang ma nor bar ston pa dpung bzang gi rgyud/ khyad par 'jug pa'i spyod pa'i skabs kyi dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi cho ga ston pa gsang ba spyi rgyud de/ de nyid las/ de nas gzhan yang gsang ba'i rgyud// dkyil 'khor dag ni thams cad kyi// spyi yi cho ga rgyas pa dag /mdor bsdus rab tu bshad par bya// zhes gsungs la/ de spyi'i cho gar 'gro rgyu'i dkyil 'khor de dag kyang bya ba'i rgyud kyi dkyil 'khor sum stong lnga brgya kho na ste/ de nyid du/ gzhan gyis mi thub la sogs gang*// de bzhin gshegs pa'i dkyil 'khor dang*// rab tu gnas pa la sogs gang*// padma'i rigs kyi bshad pa dag /'jig rten dag la brtse phyir ngas// rnam par gnod pa la sogs pa// dkyil 'khor sum stong dag dang ni// lnga brgyar bshad pa gang yin pa// dkyil 'khor de dag rnams kyi spyi'i// cho ga de ni ngas bshad de// de lta bas na cho ga 'dis// dkyil 'khor thams cad bri bar bya// zhes nges bzung du mdzad pa'i phyir ro// 'ga' zhig 'dis rgyud sde gong ma dag gi'ang spyi'i cho ga bstan no snyam sems pa ni rnam dpyod zhan par zad do// de ltar dbang gi rgyud smin nas sgrub thabs la 'jug par byed pa la/ sbyor ba'i cho ga gtso bor ston pa bsam gtan phyi ma/

sbyor ba dang grub pa'i spyod pa thun mong du ston pa legs par grub pa'i rgyud de spyi rgyud bzhi'o/ spyod pa'i rgyud bod du 'gyur ba ni rnam snang mngon byang ste/ gzhan phyag na rdo rje dbang bskur ba la sogs pa ni slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang bas/ de nas gzhan pa'i 'dul ba dag la ni dad pa'i sgo nas bya ba'i lugs can gyi rgyud phyi'i bya ba'i khyad par yang dag par bstan pa thabs dang shes rab la goms pa gtso bor mdzad pa dang gzhan gyi don phun sum tshogs par byed pa dag bstan te/ 'di ltar 'phags pa dam tshig gsum gyi rgyal po dang*/ sku gsum gyi gtsug tor dang*/ phyag na rdo rje dbang bskur ba la sogs pa dag yin no zhes bya rgyud du mdzad la/ slob dpon dzñā na bo dhis/ phyag na rdo rje dbang bskur ba zhes bya ba spyod pa'i rgyud las kyang zhes gsungs pa dang*/ jo bo rje'i lam sgron gyi rang 'grel las kyang*/ spyod pa'i rgyud ni rnam par snang mdzad mngon par byang chub pa'i rgyud/ lag na rdo rje dbang bskur ba'i rgyud la sogs pa rgyud sde stong phrag brgyad bzhugs so// zhes spyod rgyud du gsungs so// rnam snang mngon byang gi 'grel pa sangs rgyas gsang bas mdzad pa las/ rnam par snang mdzad mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa rnam par sprul pa byin gyis rlob pa'i rgyud don dam pa'i tshul rab tu bsgrags pa bsgrub pa'i sbyor ba thabs dang shes rab la goms pa sngon du 'gro ba yang dag par ston pa phyi'i gtsang sbra yod pa la sogs pa sgrub pa rnam par smad pa don dam pa'i rnal 'byor la goms pa'i rgyur gyur pa bstan pa 'di'ang gdul ba'i skye bo bya ba'i rgyud kyi lugs de lta bu la mos pa dag gzung ba'i phyir bya ba'i rgyud do zhes bsgrags so zhes bshad pas rnam snang mngon byang yang bya rgyud du bzhed do snyam na ma yin te/ lung de nyid kyis/ rgyud 'di gdul bya gzhan drang ba'i ched du bya ba'i rgyud kyi ming gis bstan pa zhig kyang yod pa dang*/

de dgongs pa can du bstan pas so// des na rgyud de ni spyod rgyud kyi de bzhin gshegs rigs kyi rgyud yin la/ lag na rdo rje dbang bskur ba la sogs pa spyod rgyud du bzhed pa dag rdo rje'i rigs su gsung ngo*/ rnal 'byor gyi rgyud la/ de nyid 'dus pa la sogs pa rtsa ba'i rgyud/ rdo rje rtse mo la sogs pa bshad pa'i rgyud/ dpal mchog dang po la sogs pa phyi ma'i rgyud do// bla med kyi pha rgyud la rigs drug tu bshad pa'i dang po// mi bskyod pa'i rigs la/ gsang 'dus dang*/ rdo rje rigs kyi khro bo// phyag rdor gyi skor/ rnam snang sgyu 'phrul drwa ba dang*/ sku'i rigs kyi khro bo gshin rje gshed kyi skor/ rin po che'i rigs kyi rgyud ni rin chen 'byung gnas dang*/ nam mkha'i snying po la sogs pa'i rgyud de bod na med/ 'od dpag med kyi rgyud ni/ 'od dpag med dang spyan ras gzigs kyi skor yin la/ bod na ral pa gcig pa'i brtag pa tsam min pa med ces bu ston gsung ngo*// las rigs kyi rgyud don grub dang bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i skor kyang bod na med/ zla gsang thig le drug pa rdo rje 'chang gi rgyud do// rnal 'byor ma rgyud la dpal sangs rgyas thams cad dang mnyam par sbyor ba mkha' 'gro ma sgyu ma bde mchog rigs drug mnyam par ston pa'i rgyud/ bde dgyes/ sangs rgyas thod pa/ sgyu 'phrul chen mo/ a ra li gnyis/ dus kyi 'khor lo dang bcas pa rnams he ru ka'i rgyud/ gdan bzhi pa rnam snang gi rgyud/ rdo rje bdud rtsi rdo rje nyi ma'i rgyud/ padma'i 'bar ba'i rgyud chen po la sogs pa padma gar dbang gi rgyud/ sgrol ma mngon par 'byung ba'i rgyud la sogs pa rta mchog gi rgyud/ ji bzhin brnyes pa nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i rgyud la sogs pa drug pa rdo rje 'chang gi rigs kyi rgyud de/ de ltar bdun du bshad do// de dag kyang bzhugs tshul gyi sgo nas rtsa ba'i rgyud/

brtag pa'i rgyud/ rgyud phyi ma/ phyi ma'i phyi ma/ bshad pa'i rgyud/ snying po'i rgyud/ 'bras bu'i rgyud/ shin tu rmad du byung ba'i rgyud brgyad du phye ste/ ye shes thig ler/ de ltar rim pa thams cad ni// lha mo de nyid shes par bya// sa bon las ni myu gu bzhin// rgyud kun rim shes rim pas so// zhes pas sa bon la myu gu nas 'bras bu'i bar rim pas 'byung ba bzhin du/ rtsa ba'i rgyud las rgyud gzhan rnams rim pa bzhin 'byung bas don gyi rim pas bzhugs pa yin la/ rgyud kun rim shes zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ rgyud gzhan thams cad la'ang mtshungs pa 'grel par bshad do// 'di'i shin tu rmad du byung ba'i rgyud/ lha mo brgyad po sku dang bral// de phyir smra bar mi btub bo// zhes pa 'di gzhan dag bde stong gi myong ba la bshad kyang ma yin te/ bka' yang dag pa'i tshad ma zhes bya ba slob dpon te lo pas 'og min gyi gnas nas spyan drangs pa rgyud thams cad kyi nges pa ston pa'i rgyud 'di yin no// rgyu mtshan/ rtsa ba'i rgyud sa bon lta bu nas/ 'bras rgyud 'brur chags pa'i dpe can gyi bar bshad nas/ brgyad pa shin tu rmad du byung ba'i rgyud ni 'bras bu longs spyod pa lta bu/ de thams cad kyi don bsgrub pa'i thabs kyis nyams su myong bar byed pa'o// yang na dbang mdor bstan las/ rgyud la mdor bstan rnam gsum dang*// rgyas par bshad pa gsum du 'gyur// zhes kyang gsungs so// lnga pa 'chad tshul gyi rnam par gzhag pa zhib mor bshad pa ni/ dpung bzang gis zhus pa'i rgyud kyi 'grel pa las bshad pa ltar/ 'jug pa dang*/ sbyor ba dang*/ 'grub pa dang*/ grub pa'i spyod pa dang bzhis bya ba'i rgyud rnams bshad par bya ba la/ rgyud gang la thams cad ma tshang zhing mi gsal ba dag la/ bya ba spyi'i bshad pa'i rgyud bzhis kha bskang ste bshad par bya'o// spyod pa'i rgyud/ rnam snang mngon byang gi 'grel par bshad pa ltar/

gdul bya dbang rnon 'go smos pas go ba la rgyud gyi mtshan tsam dang*/ dbang 'bring rnam par phye bas go ba la ming de nyid kyis don rab tu phye ba tsam brjod pa dang*/ dbang rtul tshig lhur len pa gyis so// rnal 'byor bla med kyi bshad pa ni/ ye shes rdo rje kun las btus nas bshad thabs kyi yan lag rgyan bdun du gsungs te/ gleng bslang ba lnga/ 'tshang rgya ba'i tshul bzhi/ rgyas bshad mtha' pa'i tshul sgron ma gsal ba las rgyas par bshad pa dang*/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo las phyi nang gzhan gsum gyis bshad pa'i tshul lam nā ro 'grel chen las/ drang ba dang nges pa'i don gyi rim pas rgyas
